doc:
Claimant reports neck pain: the route escalates, the agent gives safety guidance, still works the checklist, and closes
    with the urgent-review wording instead of stalling on 'finishing my notes'.
agent_turns: Hello, Jordan, I'm here to help with your claim. Are you and everyone else in a safe place right now?
Please contact emergency services if anyone is in danger and be sure to seek medical care for your neck. I'm noting this, and a human representative will review your packet.
To help me understand what happened, could you turn on your camera and show me the damage to your vehicle?
That's fine. Do you have a police report or any information from the other driver?
I understand. Did you happen to collect the other driver's insurance or contact details?
I'm noting that. Please make sure to seek medical care for your neck as soon as possible.
Could you tell me who was injured and if anyone has received medical treatment?

Please consider resting your neck, applying ice gently, and avoiding any sudden movements. This information is not medical advice or diagnosis; please see a healthcare professional for a proper evaluation.
Were you able to receive any medical treatment, or do you plan to see a doctor for your sore neck?
I am noting that you are able to talk.
Is there anyone else who was injured or any other information you can share about who was in your vehicle?

I'm noting that. Your claim is flagged for urgent human review, so please get medical care for your neck. Your packet is now ready; you can review it in the app, and once you submit it, an adjuster will get started on it.
